title: Covering Fire
text: “Now then, the princess has given her name. In gratitude for her mercy toward one so ignorant of their place, show your face and give your own name in return!”
Just whose position do you think you’re speaking from, I wonder?
“How terribly full of yourself… so there were still ones like this crawling around… Really, no matter how many times we scrub them out, more keep sprouting up.”
Itsuki, radiating murderous intent from inside the carriage, was reaching for his bow.
“Itsuki, calm down. We’re still just observing for now. Though… given the strange air he’s giving off, some caution is warranted.”
Ren was holding Itsuki back.
“Which of us is the one ignorant of their place, I wonder? Did Mother instruct you to address people with such a high-handed attitude? Mind your words.”
Fiancée was scolding the knight right there on the spot.
“H-hah! Y-yes!”

Foolish creatures, always ready to turn a blade on Fiancée the moment an opening appeared. Should I slaughter this one too, I wondered? Best to strike once its true colors showed. Since I already knew how this would play out, I supposed I ought to prepare myself as well. Fiancée turned to face Father.

“My apologies for my subordinate’s rudeness. I have heard that you’ve endured tremendous hardships in this country. Despite that, hearing that you continue striving to uplift our nation without losing heart, I came here myself to apologize on behalf of my father and elder sister for their discourtesy.”

Even with Fiancée’s apology, the crimes of the Crimson Swine and Trash remained unforgivable. Well, Itsuki seemed to be eyeing the knight and Fiancée with predatory focus from inside the carriage, bow drawn, clearly itching to turn them both into pincushions… but obviously I couldn’t let him hit Fiancée.
“Rafumi, if it comes down to it, you’ll shield Fiancée, won’t you?”
“Sure. I suppose I could do that much. Though I don’t think this is really the moment to butt in and steal someone else’s spotlight.”
In any case, I couldn’t allow Fiancée to get hurt.
“It wouldn’t do to let Fiancée see Father’s cool side here, I say.”
“I have no intention of getting involved in that matter. Though it would be entertaining in its own way, wouldn’t it? Still, I imagine it’d be difficult, since it’s far from Shield Hero’s type.”
“Hmph… for someone who calls herself a guardian of love, you understand shockingly little.”
Rafumi’s notion of a guardian of love was really this shallow. As the Love Hunter, naturally, I understood these things.
“Just what on earth are you two even talking about?”

Ren’s remark went duly ignored. In any case, it seemed Fiancée had come here to quietly convey that she understood Father’s circumstances, using this visit as an apology. That she’d come without any apparent motive was, frankly, rather suspicious. Just what conditions had to align for this to happen, I wondered? At the very least, in the original world, she’d come to visit after the Second Wave and made quite the childish fuss about it. Something I heard afterward… she’d apparently been so harassed by Takt’s sister-pig that the stress had piled up something fierce… though where exactly I’d heard that, I couldn’t quite recall.
“It’s fine that you came to apologize to me… but I don’t think it means much if the king and princess who actually caused all this haven’t reflected on anything, do you?”
“Regarding that matter, I would like to act as their representative and reconcile with my father, at the very least — my sister is a separate matter entirely.”

Reconciling with Trash, now? There were ways to make that happen, I supposed, but could it actually be pulled off at this particular timing? Well, in the loop where I’d reunited with Fleon-chan, Trash had prepared a crystal recording of himself bowing his head to Father, so the possibility existed — but could it happen in this loop? Could I engineer it so an attempted poisoning looked like a self-inflicted accident? The Crimson Swine needed to die by my hand, in as many varied and brutal ways as possible. It really was about time to dispose of her. As for how to finish her off, I rather wanted to make her suffer the way Takt had. Or perhaps simply ship her straight off to Pig King as-is? Since Takt had already been processed, it should be possible to carry out the original world’s Father’s orders to the letter this time too. The problem was whether the queen would ever approve such a method. Could I smuggle her in secretly and present her as a gift, perhaps?
“As for my sister, I have been instructed to see that she bears responsibility accordingly.”
“Responsibility, huh… and specifically, what would that entail?”
“Er… regarding that, the plan is to ask what punishment you desire and decide from there. At the very least… stripping her of succession rights is certain.”
“I see… and the king?  Shouldn’t your mother be the one to deal with him first?”
“That would be—”
“You there! Are you saying you refuse Melty-sama’s request!?”

Ah, so it seemed events were unfolding exactly as I remembered. The knight had barged right into the middle of Father and Fiancée’s conversation. No doubt the plan from here was to pin some crime on Father. Even so… with both Ren and Itsuki right here, what on earth were these Three Heroes Church lackeys thinking, pulling a stunt like this? Utterly incomprehensible.
“I’ve been wondering for a while now, but the conversation isn’t over yet, so could you please be quiet?”

Father, already half-anticipating what was coming, scolded the knight with visible irritation. Since he’d clearly foreseen this, Fiancée would be fine no matter what happened. Rafumi, too, looked fully prepared to cast an illusion at a moment’s notice. And Filo-tan and all the Filolial-samas had already shifted into full alert.
“Someone back there’s filming something like this is their big chance. I can see them holding up the same equipment the nobles use when they record torture footage.”

Panda and Elephant, already stationed in the rear carriage, tightened their guard and began circling stealthily to seal off the escape routes without drawing attention. With far more personnel present than during our stay in Melromarc, any suspicious move by this country’s lot would get caught instantly. If anything, the real struggle here was figuring out how to shut Fiancée up. Or rather, given the sheer number of people present, anyone who thought they could pull something shady and still get away with it had to be living in some kind of fantasy world.
“Hey, hey, this guy’s saying stuff he doesn’t even mean~”
Shuffle… shuffle… Filo-tan crept closer, worried for Fiancée amid the ominous atmosphere.
“Stay away from the princess, you vile beast!”
Of course, Éclair and Crocodile Guy were also nearby, positioned close enough to step between the knight and Fiancée at any moment.
“Stop this at once! We came here for the Shield Hero-sama and reconciliation—”
The knight, utterly failing to know his place, smiled and swung his blade at Fiancée — but Éclair had already drawn her sword, knocked his blade aside, and leveled her sword at his throat.
“Radiating murderous intent and drawing on Princess Melty — just what did you think you were doing?”
“Y-you—!? Damn you, Shield and your savage demi-humans! Taking the princess hostage!”
“Come again?”
“What on earth are you even saying?”

Éclair, seemingly at a loss for words, pressed her sword forward as if interrogating him, but the knight kept right on smiling. Naturally Filo-tan was already there, and now Crocodile Guy stepped in as well, shielding Fiancée.
“Hostage? Hah… which of us was the one about to pull something dangerous here?”

“There is no need for Melromarc to reconcile with the devil of the Shield! That was decided from the very start! The traitor princess who sold out her country shall become the sacrifice for it! Go on, savor your fleeting little victory! You disgrace to Melromarc soldiers everywhere, you Bitch!”
The knight spat this at Éclair.
“How dare you speak to Eclair-sama that way!”
“Shion! Don’t mind him! Right now, nothing must happen to Melty-sama!”
Even so… with Éclair and Crocodile Guy here, it seemed the situation could be handled before Father or I even needed to step in.
“Shield is evil! That was decided from the beginning! Both you traitor and the treacherous princess shall vanish together!”
And so, it seemed the plan had been to receive backup from his fellow knights waiting in the rear… however—
“Oi! Hurry up! What are you dawdling for—”
The knight glanced back, only to find that every single knight stationed behind him now had an arrow buried squarely between his eyebrows.
“Gugh—”
“Gah—”
“Th-that can’t—”
The recording crystal, too, shattered with a crisp crack, pierced through just as swiftly.
“Trying anything funny is what got them killed.”
Itsuki, whose trigger finger had gotten rather quick on the draw, had already shot down the group in the rear that had been preparing to unleash spells.
